size_dependence.expression_as_printed: TOF at 298 K varies as d−1.7±0.2 for the 7.2 wt% Au/TiO2 (P25) catalyst.
size_dependence.notes: The conclusion also states approximately d−1.8 for the 7.2 wt% catalyst over mean particle size 2–10 nm. Discussion reports atomic-rate exponents separately; those were not used here because this field is for TOF.

size_dependence.expression_as_printed: TOF at 298 K varies as d−0.9±0.2 for the 4.5 wt% Au/TiO2 (P25) catalyst.
size_dependence.notes: The conclusion also states approximately d−1.0 for the 4.5 wt% catalyst over mean particle size 2–10 nm. Discussion reports atomic-rate exponents separately; those were not used here because this field is for TOF.

extraction_notes: The paper reports CO oxidation activity mainly as atomic rate, CO/(total Au s), and TOF, not as a rate per gram catalyst. Therefore co_oxidation_rate fields are null and the printed activity values are preserved in notes. Total gas flow is not printed for each Table 3 entry; F/W and catalyst masses are printed, but total flow was not computed. Pressure is not stated. The reactant is printed as dry 1% CO in air; O2 mole fraction is not separately printed. Average Au diameters are the printed d values in Tables 1 and 2, obtained by the authors from EXAFS 1NN coordination numbers using a truncated cubo-octahedron model.
